reviews.author: Jennifer K.
reviews.text: AC died on the hottest day of the summer. Clark's had a tech at our house in three hours, fixed it for under $200. We're customers for life.

reviews.author: Tom W.
reviews.text: Got three quotes for a new furnace. Clark's was the only one that actually checked our existing system instead of just trying to upsell. Saved us $4k.

reviews.author: Ashley P.
reviews.text: Maintenance plan is worth every penny. They catch stuff before it becomes a midnight emergency. Highly recommend.

about.story: I worked at a big HVAC company for ten years before starting Clark's. Watched them push replacements that customers didn't need and charge for repairs that took fifteen minutes. I started this business to do it the way I always thought it should be done — show up, tell the truth, fix it right, charge what's fair.
